meta_description: Your company's chain: its structure, rights, decisions, resources and agents.
structure_empty: No unit at this date. Start with a unit type, then the top unit.
field_key_hint: Lowercase, no space: branch, legal_entity, team.
error_forbidden: Only owners and admins change the structure.
error_cycle: A unit cannot go under itself or one of its own units.
error_closed: This is closed at that date.
error_primary_overlap: This person already has a primary assignment over that period.
error_ends_before_start: The end cannot come before the start.
error_not_found: This does not exist in your organization.
error_invalid_input: Check the fields: a value does not fit.
error_generic: That did not go through. Try again in a moment.
rights_none: No particular right: you see the units where you hold a position.
rights_holder: To a position or a person
error_duplicate: This already exists under that name.
field_address_hint: In https: its identity card is read there (/.well-known/kete).
error_own_request: A person does not decide her own request.
error_already_pending: A promotion request is already waiting for this resource.
circuits_none: No circuit: each feature keeps its own review.
circuit_threshold_hint: Empty: always. For a resource: 1 low risk, 2 medium or unknown, 3 high.
error_unknown_subject: This kind of request does not exist.
error_in_circuit: This promotion is decided in its circuit, from the Inbox.
gateway_explain: Add this MCP address to Claude, ChatGPT or any copilot: it will see what you see, and act for you, never beyond your rights.
gateway_how: In Claude: Settings, Connectors, Add a custom connector, then paste the address. It will ask you to sign in.
agents_none: No agent works for you yet.
compliance_forbidden: Compliance is read with the « See compliance » permission over the whole organization.
frameworks_none: No framework: start with the one that has a real deadline.
requirement_summary_hint: In your own words: a standard's text is never copied.
check_registry_apps_have_card: Every app has its card and its owner
check_agents_act_for_someone: Every position's agent has someone to act for
document_write: Write a document or a new version
error_unknown_check: This automatic check does not exist.
error_not_automatic: This control is attested by a person.
error_own_writing: A version is approved by someone other than its author.
error_not_owner: Only the person it is assigned to says an action is done.
error_not_done: The action is not done yet.
error_own_action: Effectiveness is verified by someone else.
demo_viewing: You are viewing {name}'s space, with their rights.
admin_explain: The organization's frame: who is who, who may do what, which tools are on. The tools' content belongs to the business owners, in their space.
admin_rights: Roles and grants, by position and scope
admin_circuits: Who approves what, described as data
admin_registry: Apps, MCP servers, skills and agents, with their tier and risk
admin_agents: {active} active agent(s), each serving a person
admin_ai_none: No model set: briefings follow rules
modules_explain: Each business tool is switched on for the whole organization. Switched off, it leaves the spaces; its data stays.
module_surveys: Questionnaires, campaigns sent by link, answers and results: staff, customer and intern satisfaction, evaluations.
module_performance: Indicators with six attributes, grids per position, objectives, protocols and the quarterly review up to performance factors.
module_meetings: Meetings, agendas drawn from the gaps, decision records, decision notes and the action register.
module_compliance: Frameworks, controls, evidence, audits, findings and corrective actions.
module_agents: Permanent agents with a job description, who watch and report.
people_import_explain: Paste one line per person, from a spreadsheet: name ; e-mail ; phone ; position title. Each person gets the position as primary, from today. Someone who signs in with that e-mail finds herself on her own.
people_counts: {people} people, {linked} with an account. The others receive their personal links by e-mail.
circuits_forbidden: Circuits are managed with the « decisions: manage » permission.
outbox_capture: Test mode: no e-mail leaves. Each one stays here, and its links work as for its recipient.
outbox_send: Send mode: e-mails leave through the provider and do not stay here.
demo_explain: This organization is a demo: its people and their e-mails are fictitious. Open someone's space to see and act with their rights, never more.
demo_by_link_explain: These people have no account: they receive their links by e-mail. Open the test outbox to follow them.
link_invalid_title: This link is no longer valid
link_invalid: It may have expired, or a new link was sent to you. Ask the person who sent it.
error_module_disabled: This tool is not on in your organization.
error_view_as_forbidden: Only an administrator of a demo organization may view another person's space.
error_link_invalid: This link is no longer valid.
about_none: The organization (or the units of the sections)
audience_outside_list: One line per person: name ; e-mail
campaign_min_group_hint: Below it, an anonymous campaign shows no score for the group.
campaign_opened: {respondents} people surveyed: {sent} links sent, {relayed} to pass on by hand (sent to you).
campaign_remind_action: Remind those who have not answered
campaign_reminded: {count} reminders sent, with a new link.
campaign_closed_done: Campaign closed: its links no longer open.
campaign_published_done: Results published: they feed the indicators.
questionnaire_anonymous: Anonymous: once sent, answers are no longer tied to their author
questionnaire_used: used: copy it to change it
respondent_no_email: no e-mail: link passed on by hand
results_explain: {forms} forms received. Score on 100: (average − 1) ÷ 4 × 100, « not applicable » left out. A group of fewer than {min} answers shows no score.
survey_intro: {name}, here are your forms for {period}, to send before {closes}.
survey_anonymous: Your answers are anonymous: once sent, they are no longer tied to your name.
survey_scale: 1 = not satisfied at all · 5 = very satisfied
survey_sent: Thank you, your form is sent.
survey_incomplete: Some required questions are still unanswered.
surveys_explain: Campaigns sent by personal link, their follow-up and results; then the questionnaires they use.
error_used: A campaign already used this questionnaire: copy it to change it.
factor_fallback: Review not held: factor set to the average of the last two quarters, and the failure reported to HR.
performance_explain: The quarters and their reviews, then the job profiles: each grid with its six attributes. A colour obliges to act; missing data counts as red, charged to the management.
performance_profiles_explain: Imported from the indicators referential. A position takes the profile that carries its title.
quarter_open_action: Open: freeze and notify the grids
quarter_opened: {reviews} reviews opened: {sent} grids notified by e-mail, {relayed} to pass on by hand.
quarter_measures_closed: Measures closed: {missing} lines without a value turn red.
quarter_closed_done: Quarter closed: {missed} reviews not held get the average of their last two quarters.
record_protocols_hint: The manager's note, based on dated deviations. Outside variable pay.
record_not_signed_manager: Not yet signed by the manager
record_not_signed_person: Not yet signed by the person
record_waiting: The record is written once the measures are closed.
review_link_intro: {name}, position « {position} ». Your indicators do not change during the quarter.
review_acknowledge_explain: Your indicators are notified in writing before they apply. Confirm you have read them.
team_explain: The reviews of the people who report to you: write and sign their record once the measures are closed.
validate_explain: Consistency across directions: the same performance must earn the same appraisal. Validation freezes the factors.
error_not_reviewer: Only the person's manager writes and signs first.
error_wrong_step: This is not the step for that gesture.
decision_owner: {name}, by {due} — in the register of actions
decision_idea: idea kept in the innovation register
meeting_planned_done: Meeting planned: {items} items drawn from the gaps.
meeting_record_waiting: The record is published once the meeting is held.
meetings_explain: Meetings start from the gaps — indicators in red, overdue actions — and end with dated actions. Decision notes take the year's next number.
assistant_explain: Your assistant acts for you, with your rights and never more: it sees what you see, prepares and explains, and never decides for you. It has no pay data.
assistant_unavailable: The assistant is not configured for your organization yet.
assistant_thinking: The assistant is reading your registers…
resources_explain: The apps, skills, MCP servers and agents your space, your team and the organization open to you, with their owner. To add one, register it.
ai_no_model: No model is configured: the briefing is written by rules, the assistant is unavailable.
ai_model_explain: The model is chosen in the instance's environment, never from a screen; its key shows nowhere.
ai_budget_explain: Past it, no call is made until next month: the briefing falls back to rules.
structure_explain: Units, positions and their holders at a date: the chart, the tree or the table.
my_agents_explain: The agents acting for you: their mission, scope, level and signals. An agent never holds more rights than you.
resources_none: No resource of this kind at this tier.
actions_explain: What meetings decided, what indicators call for, what audits ask: one owner, one deadline.
error_budget_spent: The organization's monthly AI budget is spent: an administrator can raise it.
error_model_failed: The model did not answer. Try again in a moment.
error_signed_out: Your session expired: sign in again.
assistant_suggestion_day: What should I do first today?
assistant_suggestion_readings: Which app readings can I take into the reviews?
assistant_suggestion_team: Where does my team stand this quarter?
assistant_placeholder: Ask; the assistant prepares; you decide.
assistant_hint: {model} · the assistant acts with your rights and prepares drafts you validate.
assistant_hint_rules: The assistant acts with your rights and prepares drafts you validate.
draft_title_measure: Measure of a review line · draft
inbox_drafts_explain: Your agents prepare; nothing exists until you validate.
apr_explain: Ask for the app your team needs: IT decides, then the factory creates it, connects it to the system and codes a first version you review.
apr_new_explain: Describe the need in plain words. IT uses it to decide, the factory and the coding agent to build.
apr_section_need_body: What the app must do, and for whom.
apr_section_data_body: What the app handles, and what an outage costs: IT deduces the controls from it.
apr_slug_hint: Lowercase, digits and dashes: it names the kete-… repository
apr_purpose_hint: At least 20 characters: the tasks, the screens, the rules.
apr_approve_body: The factory creates the repository, the database, the Compte Kete sign-in and the hosting, then an agent codes a first version.
apr_reason: Reason, for the person who asked
apr_factory_off: The factory is not configured: an approved request waits.
criticality_high: Work stops, or money is lost
criticality_critical: Safety, legal obligations or every customer
error_factory_unreachable: The factory does not answer: send again later.
rights_no_app_permissions: No app in the registry declares its permissions yet.
rights_apps_explain: An app's permissions come from its identity card. As soon as a role carries one, these rights apply in the app instead of its defaults.
ai_connection_explain: Bring your own key: your assistant and your agents then spend your tokens, not the organization's.
ai_connection_model_hint: Its identifier at the provider, for instance gpt-6.1-sol.
ai_connection_key_hint: Tried once at the provider, kept encrypted, never shown again.
ai_connection_none: No key connected: you use the organization's model.
ai_connection_unavailable: This instance keeps no secret yet: ask its operator to set its encryption key.
ai_policy_allowed: Anyone may bring a key; otherwise, the organization pays
ai_policy_required: Everyone uses their own key; the organization pays for no one
ai_policy_off: The organization pays for everyone; no personal key
ai_policy_allowed_person: You may bring your own key. Without it, you use the organization's model.
ai_policy_required_person: Your organization asks everyone to use their own key: without it, your assistant does not answer.
ai_policy_off_person: Your organization pays for everyone's models: no personal key.
error_provider_unreachable: The provider does not answer: try again later.
error_personal_off: Your organization does not allow personal keys.
chat_mentions: Mention a person or an app
chat_attach: Attach a file (PDF, Word, text, image)
cmd_summarize_body: The conversation and the files in a few points
cmd_write_body: A document in the canvas: letter, note, report
cmd_explain_body: As to someone new to the subject
cmd_actions_body: With owner and deadline, as drafts to validate
chat_hint: @ to mention, / for a command, drop a file. {model}
error_unsupported_file: This kind of file is not read: PDF, Word, text, CSV or image.
error_unreadable_file: This file could not be read.
ai_subscription_explain: Use the ChatGPT subscription you already pay for. It signs in on a machine of your own, never on Kete's servers, and answers from what you give it, without Kete Enterprise's tools.
ai_subscription_step: Open the sign-in page, sign in to your account, then enter this code (valid 15 minutes):
ai_subscription_signing_in: Signing in: finish on the sign-in page, then click « I'm done ».
ai_subscription_waiting: Not signed in yet: finish on the sign-in page, then try again.
ai_subscription_unavailable: This instance does not offer subscriptions yet: ask its operator.
error_payer_refused: Your organization does not allow this way to pay.
error_subscription_lost: Your subscription no longer answers: connect it again in « My AI connection ».
schedules_explain: Your morning briefing, or a question your assistant answers at a set time, with your rights. The answer lands in « To do », and by e-mail if you wish.
schedules_none: No scheduled task. You can also ask the assistant: « every Monday at 8, my team's late actions ».
schedules_prompt_hint: For example: which actions of my team are late?
schedules_ran: Done: the answer is in « To do ».
schedules_ran_briefing: Done: your briefing is on your home page.
error_too_many_schedules: You already have twenty scheduled tasks: remove one first.
view_failed: This view could not open: the result stays in the answer.
module_knowledge: The company's library: procedures, notes, templates and reports, searched with their sources, each person within what she may read.
library_explain: The company's documents you may read. Each answer cites its document and page; the assistant uses them too.
library_search_hint: For example: what does our procedure say about a customer complaint?
library_none: No passage found in what you may read.
library_no_source: No source is open yet. An administrator adds them in Administration.
library_unavailable: This instance has no embedding model yet: ask its operator.
kadmin_explain: Add sources, open each to everyone, to units (with their teams) or to administrators, and switch them off when needed: documents stay, search ignores them.
kadmin_none: No source. Start with « New source ».
error_knowledge_unavailable: This instance has no embedding model yet: ask its operator.
memory_title: What the assistant remembers about you
memory_explain: Your preferences and what you asked it to remember. It uses them in every conversation and scheduled task; only you see them, and you erase them whenever you want.
memory_add_hint: For example: my reports in French, amounts in FCFA.
memory_none: Nothing yet. Tell it « remember that… » in the chat, or add it here.
error_memory_full: Fifty memories at most: forget one first.
notif_explain: What happened for you. What asks for an action stays in « To do ».
notif_device_unsupported: This browser does not receive notifications.
notif_device_denied: Notifications are blocked for this site in your browser.
notif_push_off: This instance does not send notifications to devices yet.
search_explain: One question across what you may see: conversations, actions, decisions, people, apps, library.
search_none: Nothing found in what you may see.
error_push_off: This instance does not send notifications to devices yet.
module_dossiers: One space per subject, shared by its members: its documents (read by them only), conversations, actions and links.
dossiers_explain: One space per subject: the ISO audit, the SAV review. Its members find its documents, conversations, actions.
dossiers_none: No dossier. Open one for a subject you share.
dossier_no_link: Nothing yet. Add a link, or range a conversation from the assistant.
module_documents: The organization’s Word templates, filled for each person in Word or PDF, by the assistant or here.
documents_explain: Your organization’s templates, and the documents you produced from them. Only you see them.
admin_templates_explain: Upload a Word document where each field is written in braces, for instance client or date in braces. Fields are recognized on upload.
admin_templates_pdf_off: PDF conversion is not configured: templates are filled in Word.
error_pdf_unavailable: PDF conversion is not configured here.
error_pdf_failed: The PDF conversion failed. Try again in a moment.
error_template_invalid: This file is not a usable Word template.
module_skills: The organization’s know-how, read by the assistant when it fits: kept from a conversation, or brought from Claude and ChatGPT.
skills_explain: Instructions written once, followed by the assistant when a request fits. In the Agent Skills format: they move to and from Claude, ChatGPT and Codex.
error_skill_name_taken: A skill already has this name.
error_skill_invalid: This file is not a skill in the Agent Skills format.
error_no_cases: This skill has no test case (evals/evals.json).
record_assist_explain: Upload the meeting’s recording or paste its transcript: the assistant proposes the record and the decisions, you correct them, then publish. The recording is not kept.
module_datasets: The teams’ tables (Excel, CSV), read by the assistant and the dashboards: every figure comes from the rows.
datasets_explain: Upload an Excel, OpenDocument or CSV table: its columns are recognized (numbers, dates, texts) and the assistant can draw figures from it. It is yours alone until an administrator opens it to others.
error_invalid_query: This query does not fit these columns.
module_forms: Simple collections, answered in the space or by a link without an account, validated by a circuit, read as data.
forms_explain: A collection in a few fields: expense claims, requests, registrations. Each answer may go through an approval circuit; the answers read as data.
forms_circuit_hint: To have each answer approved, an administrator defines this form’s circuit in Administration › Circuits.
error_invalid_answer: An answer does not fit: check the fields.
module_dashboards: Cards over the teams’ data and the forms’ answers, composed by each person or proposed by the assistant; each reader sees only what she may read.
dashboards_explain: Compose your cards, or ask the assistant: “make me an SAV dashboard”. A proposal is yours to keep.
dashboards_hidden: You have no access to this card’s source.
agent_task_explain: The agent works on it in the background with your rights, limited to its job description; what commits waits for you as a draft. You are told when it ends.
today_nothing: Nothing waits for you. Have a good day.
today_more: See the {count} others in To do
today_pinned_empty: Pin a dashboard to find it here, up to date.
all_explain: Everything your modules and rights open. Ctrl K leads there too, from any screen.
todo_given: Given: you will be told when it ends.
todo_ask_question: Explain the request “{title}”: what argues for it, what against, with your sources.
todo_analysis_explain: The assistant looks, with your rights, for what sheds light on the decision and cites its sources. It does not decide: you do.
todo_write: Write to those the request concerns…
panel_welcome: What would you like to know?
panel_seeing: I see: {title}. What would you like to know?
panel_explain_page: Sum up what I am looking at
panel_pin_ask: Turn your answer into a view and pin it to my Today.
panel_every_monday_ask: Ask me this same question every Monday at 8.
sidebar_remove_section: Remove the section; its shortcuts move to the first one
sidebar_add_none: All your pages are already in the sidebar.
sidebar_fixed: Today and To do always stay. Your changes follow your account on all your devices.
sidebar_empty_section: Pin a page with “Pin to the sidebar”.
sidebar_failed: Your sidebar could not be saved. Try again.
dashboards_not_filtered: Not filtered: its source has no such column.
dashboards_click_filters: A click on a bar filters the whole board.
dashboards_editing: You are editing this board: drag a card by its handle, resize it by its corner, open its settings. “Done” saves it, and keeps the previous state as a version.
dashboards_fork_banner: You are reading someone else’s board. To arrange it your way, make your version: the original does not change.
dashboards_forked: Your version of a shared board: the original does not change.
dashboards_versions_none: No version yet: every change will keep one.
dashboards_versions_explain: Restoring keeps the current state as a version: nothing is lost.
dashboards_no_cards: This board has no card yet. Add one, or ask the assistant what you want to see.
routines_explain: What happens for you without you: at a set time, when an app signals, on watch over a figure. Always with your rights; every run is kept.
routines_sentence_hint: For instance: “Every Friday at 4 pm, sum up the week’s tickets”, “When a critical ticket arrives, tell me which technician is free”, “Warn me when the average delay goes over 3 days”.
routines_rights: With your rights, never more. Nothing starts before you activate it.
routines_family_time_explain: Every day, every working day or every week, at a time.
routines_family_event_explain: When an app of your team announces an event.
routines_family_watch_explain: When a figure of a dashboard crosses a line; checked every hour.
routines_add_time: Create a task at a set time
routines_add_event: Create a routine on an event
routines_tried_notice: Try finished: its outcome is in the latest runs.
routines_no_apps: No app of your team announces events yet.
routines_no_figures: No dashboard with a figure to watch.
agent_autonomy: What it does alone, by kind of task
agent_autonomy_explain: Never above its maximum level. Committing always goes through a draft you decide.
agent_level_2: Act where it can be undone
agent_from_sentence: Create an agent in a sentence
agent_sentence: What it should do for you
agent_sentence_hint: For instance: “An agent that follows up overdue decisions and tells me in the morning”.
agent_created: Agent created. It will act with your rights, never more.
governance_feedback_share: {helpful} useful answers out of {judged} judged this month
governance_feedback_none: Nobody judged an answer this month yet.
governance_journal_explain: Every action of an agent or the assistant: who, for whom, through which channel, and whether it can be undone.
notebook_explain: What you write down, as on paper. Kete keeps it, sets a reminder in To do when a note names a moment, and your assistant uses it to understand what you are busy with. Nobody else reads it.
notebook_placeholder: E.g.: “Meeting tomorrow at 10 with Kofi on the Q3 survey”
notebook_nothing_filed: No moment named: nothing else was filed.
notebook_private: A notebook belongs to its person alone: it does not show while you view their space.
how_asked_by_person: Asked by the person it acts for
how_gesture_kept: done alone, kept in the journal
how_no_step: It answered without reading or preparing anything.
how_rights_none: No right: it can only answer.
how_rights_limit: Alone, it goes at most as far as: {level}.
how_traced: Kete shows here what was recorded as it happened, nothing else.
tool_delegate_task: Hand part of it to another agent
exchanges_explain: Your assistant can ask a colleague’s a question, and receive theirs. It answers alone only on what you allow here, with moments and counts, never what they are about. Everything else is passed to you, and you see every exchange.
exchanges_allow_title: What your assistant may say alone
exchanges_allow_explain: Nothing is allowed at first. You change your mind whenever you like; it applies to the next questions.
exchanges_allow_availability: The moments of your dated commitments in the next 7 days, without their title. No calendar is connected: Kete knows only what is dated in your To do, and says so.
exchanges_allow_workload: How many things wait in your To do, and how many are late. Never which ones.
exchanges_received_none: No assistant has asked you anything.
exchanges_sent_none: Your assistant has asked nothing. In a conversation, say for example: “Ask Kofi whether he is free on Thursday morning.”
session_start: Take my day one subject at a time
session_done: {settled} subject(s) settled, {later} set aside. Nothing else waits for you in this session.
today_all_later: Everything else is set aside for today.
meanwhile_none: Nothing is running right now: no agent, no routine.
dictation_reading: One moment, writing what you said…
dictation_kept_explain: Only you see it. Your assistant knows it: ask it to file it or pass it on.
dictation_unsupported: This browser cannot record. Write your report below.
dictation_no_microphone: The microphone is not available. Allow it, or write your report below.
error_page_title: This page could not be shown
error_page_body: Nothing was changed. Try again, or go back to what waits for you.
chat_queue_remove: Take it out of the line
tool_team_data_rows: Reading the rows of a data set
table_truncated: The table stops here: the rest is at its source.
document_not_found: This document does not exist, or is not open to you.
document_truncated: The document is long: the rest is not shown here.
pieces_title: Files and media of the thread
pieces_produced: Made by the assistant and the agents
pieces_unreadable: This file can no longer be opened.
requests_explain: Work asked of a person, with its state. She organises herself as she wants; what she returns is signed by her.
requests_colleague_hint: Their name, as the directory shows it.
request_not_found: This request does not exist, or is not yours.
request_text_to: What you return, or what you ask back
request_signed_prepared: Prepared by {agent}, read and signed by {name}.
request_event_handed: {name} hands the work to their agent
error_request_herself: You cannot ask yourself for work.
error_request_ambiguous: Several people have this name: be more precise.
error_request_not_hers: This gesture belongs to the other person of the request.
error_request_not_possible: The request has moved on: reload the page.
error_request_not_her_agent: Only one of your own agents can do this work for you.
agent_task_write_explain: Your words come before the instruction. If it is working, it stops at its next step and starts again with them.
agent_task_obeying: It stops at its next step.
agent_task_steered_taken: Taken over by {name}, {at}. What it had done is kept.
agent_state_paused_agent: It no longer makes its round nor takes a task.
agent_visibility_explain: A colleague who calls it makes it act with their own rights, never with yours. The administrator sees it in the registry.
agents_shared_explain: Colleagues open them to you. They act with your rights, never with their owner’s.
error_task_settled: This task is over: nothing changes it any more.
reception_explain: What arrives at you, and who takes care of it. With nothing set, everything arrives at you. Who asks sees a state, never your rules nor your private agents.
reception_safeguards: A rule names only one of your agents. Nothing goes back without your signature. The organization stopping its agents comes before your rules.
reception_no_agent: A rule hands work to one of your agents: create one first.
reception_words_hint: One or several words, separated by commas: quote, pricing.
reception_away_set: From {from} to {to}, what is asked of you goes to {name}.
reception_trial_agent: {name} prepares the answer, by your rule “{word}”.
reception_trial_signed: What goes back is read and signed by a person.
agent_dry_run_none: Today, it would have had nothing to report.
agent_dry_run_found: Today, it would have reported {count} thing(s):
agent_dry_run_explain: Read with your rights, nothing is written. Its first round, once created, will report exactly this.
agent_created_ran: Agent created. Its first round reported {count} thing(s).
error_too_many: You already have twenty rules: remove one.
admin_rules: What agents do not do, in one sentence: tried, then switched on.
rules_explain: The organization’s rules for its agents. Each is one sentence, born on trial, tried on the last month, then switched on. It never refuses a person’s own gesture.
rules_none: No rule yet: agents follow the rights of their person.
rules_family_tools_explain: No agent uses what the rule covers: neither reading, preparing, nor acting.
rules_family_autonomy_explain: No agent acts alone on what the rule covers: it reads and prepares, a person decides.
rules_sentence_hint: As it will be shown at each refusal.
rules_later: The other families are not written as rules yet: {families}.
rule_last_month: Last 30 days: {refused} refused, {counted} counted on trial
rule_simulation: Over the last {days} days, it would have refused {refused} step(s) of the {steps} agents took.
rule_try_first: Try it on the last month before switching it on.
error_rule_not_tried: Try the rule on the last month before switching it on.
error_rule_family_later: This family is not written as a rule yet.
admin_connectors: Your existing tools, read through their MCP server: what waits lands in “Decide”.
connectors_explain: A tool the organization already has — its ERP — read through its MCP server. What waits there for a person lands in their “Decide”, and leaves it once decided in the tool. A connector reads, and nothing else.
connectors_safeguards: It calls the one tool named here, never a tool its server says writes. Its tools are given to no agent. Its credential is encrypted and never comes back.
connector_never_writes: It does not write nor delete.
connector_report: {found} waiting in the tool: {filed} for a known person, {unmatched} for nobody known, {closed} taken out of “Decide”.
connector_try_first: Try it before connecting it: the trial says what it would file, and for whom.
connector_address_hint: In https, reachable from Kete Enterprise.
connector_secret_hint: Sent as a “Bearer” token. Encrypted when saved, never shown again.
connector_tool: The tool that lists what waits
connector_tool_hint: Its exact name on this server: it changes from one server to another.
connector_label: What it is, for the person
connector_link_hint: The address of its page in the tool, with {key} in place of the identifier.
error_connector_name_taken: A connector already has this name.
error_connector_no_such_tool: Its server has no tool of this name.
error_connector_not_read_only: Its server says this tool writes: a connector only reads.
error_connector_unreadable: Its answer is not a list.
apps_explain: What stands behind the center: your existing tools read by a connector, your team’s apps, the business tools delivered with Kete. And what the center receives from each.
apps_packs_none: No business tool open to you.
apps_nothing_yet: The center receives nothing from it yet.
parties_explain: Who you work with: clients, suppliers, funders. One record per third party, cited by every app.
party_not_found: This third party does not exist, or is not open to you.
party_no_fact: No app has said anything of this third party yet.
error_already_merged: One of the two records is already merged.
projects_explain: What you work on. A project holds together its thread and files, its team, its client and its budget. You see those you belong to.
projects_name_hint: A name is enough: “Garage Bè site”. The rest comes after.
project_not_found: This project does not exist, or you are not part of it.
project_money_note: No movement of money said by an app, or this project’s money is not open to you.
project_team_note: Whoever is in the team sees the project, its thread and its files, even with no other right.
project_open_thread: Open the project’s thread and files
project_thread_off: Dossiers are not switched on for your organization.
error_unknown_party: This third party does not exist.
error_project_closed: This project is closed: reopen it to change it.
money_short_ahead: {committed} committed for {available} available: unless more comes in, {short} will be taken from other projects’ money.
money_short_now: This project spent {short} more than it received: it lives on other projects’ money.
money_outside_budget: Outside any post of the budget: {amount}
funds_explain: Reserved for projects: {reserved}. Committed in all: {committed}. What is in the bank is the treasury’s to say.
funds_short: Projects whose commitments exceed their funds: {count}
inbox_returned_note: It is the same request: what was approved stays approved, unless the amount goes up.
circuit_inform: These people are only informed: they do not decide
error_reason_required: Say what is to be corrected.
error_not_returned: This request was not sent back to you.
error_not_the_requester: Only who asked sends her request again.
phone_explain: What waits for your decision arrives on your WhatsApp or your Telegram, with « Approve » and « Refuse »: your reply decides, as in your Inbox.
phone_untied: Not tied: nothing is sent to you
phone_no_sender: The organization has tied no WhatsApp number nor Telegram bot yet: an administrator does it below.
phone_telegram_code: Open the organization’s bot in Telegram and send: /start {code}
phone_senders_explain: Messages leave from the organization’s WhatsApp Business number and Telegram bot. Their secrets are sealed and never shown again.
permission_time_record: Say the time of others (meetings, leaves, tasks)
plan_explain: The time of all of Kete: your meetings, the apps’ deadlines, leaves, tasks, the agents’ runs.
plan_clash_overlap: {name} is expected in two places: {first} and {second}, {at}.
evening_explain: Say what your day was: what is done, what slips, what to remind you of. I propose gestures on your To do; nothing changes before you tick.
evening_note_label: My day in a few words
evening_note_hint: “I finished the Garage Bè reminder; the report will wait until Monday; remind me of Ecobank on Thursday.”
evening_nothing: Nothing to propose on your To do.
evening_unclear: I did not know what to do with: {parts}
intelligence_placeholder: Ask, or hand over a task… @ to cite, / for a gesture
intelligence_hint: Writes in your Kete thread, with the page · acts with your rights · prepares, you decide
intelligence_stopped: Stopped. What was read is kept; nothing was changed.
intelligence_files_drop: Drop a file here: it joins your next question.
intelligence_intro_a: Hello {name}. I see the open page and can search all of Kete. I read, compute, compare and
for_me_subtitle: {date} · what needs you, the most pressing first
for_me_hand_back_reason: Handed back from « For me » on return.
for_me_held_none: Nothing else in progress with you.
triage_why: Kete could not tell where it belongs: it does not guess, it asks you.
triage_choose: Choose a project or a third party
triage_learned: What you choose is learned: this sender's next message goes to its thread on its own.
threads_address: Its address for replies by mail
threads_by_mail: Also by mail, from my box
threads_edit_keeps: The original is kept: it shows it was edited.
threads_empty: Nothing has been said here yet.
threads_new_group_hint: A committee, a site, a tender…
threads_none_yet: No thread yet: they are born with your projects, third parties and groups.
policy_month: This month: {allowed} allowed · {asked} approvals asked · {refused} refused
policy_month_trial: on trial, would have acted {count} times
policy_sentence_hint: Above 500,000 F, her manager approves the purchase
policy_subtitle: A sentence, its rule, its version. The same for a person and for her agent; every decision is journaled with the policy that made it. A policy is born on trial: observed before it applies.
mailboxes_subtitle: The mail a person receives lands in its file's thread; her answer leaves from her own box and stays in her Sent. Kete reads each box every minute.
mailboxes_password_hint: Sealed as it arrives; never shown again.
agents_bounds_none: No policy addresses agents for now.
agents_bounds_same: One engine for a person and her agent: an agent never does more than its person may, and these policies come before its settings.
fluidity_source: Counted by Kete on the holdings, never by a model; nothing stays without a holder: the relay sees to it.
settings_intro: Each setting says where its value comes from: Kete, the organization, the center, a unit or you.
settings_mine_hint: They follow you in every Kete app.
settings_organization_hint: For the whole organization, in Kete Enterprise. Every change is kept in the journal.
settings_refused_forbidden: Only an administrator sets the organization.
settings_refused_alone: Without a Compte Kete, your preferences are not kept.
settings_refused_unreachable: The Compte Kete does not answer, try again.
settings_unit_hint: A subsidiary or a site may have its own name, address, legal identifiers, currency, time zone, working days and hours: more precise than the organization, they win there.
settings_unit_panel_hint: What the unit sets for itself; the rest comes from the organization.
admin_tools: Your own tools — described in OpenAPI or served over MCP — given to your agents under Kete’s rules.
tools_explain: The organization’s tools — its CRM described in OpenAPI, its ticketing served by an MCP server — given to its agents. A tool that reads runs alone; a tool that acts prepares a draft someone decides; a tool that deletes needs a confirmation. Same policies, same journal as Kete.
tools_prefix_hint: Each tool carries it before its name: “crm” gives crm_list_contacts. Lowercase letters and digits, 2 to 16.
tools_address_hint: In https, on the public internet: never an address of the company’s network.
tools_base_url_hint: When the description does not say: its API’s address, in https.
tools_safeguards: Its tools are read once and kept: an agent never gets a tool nobody saw. Its credential is encrypted and never shown again. Reading needs “Read with imported tools”, acting “Act with imported tools”.
error_tools_prefix_taken: A set of tools already has this prefix.
error_tools_name_taken: One of its tools has the name of a Kete tool: choose another prefix.
error_tools_not_public: This address is not on the public internet.
error_tools_invalid_description: This is not an OpenAPI 3 description in JSON, or it does not say where its calls go.
threads_create_asked: Kete prepares the draft; it comes into the thread.
threads_create_hint: Kete prepares a draft; you validate it.
threads_kete_thinking: Kete reads the thread and answers…
threads_moved_away: Moved to another thread — see it
threads_no_mailbox: Your mailbox is not connected: the e-mail will not leave. An administrator connects it in Administration › Mailboxes.
threads_outside_asked: This message to the client waits for an approval; it leaves once approved.
threads_outside_sent: Sent to the client, approved by {name}
threads_outside_waiting: To the client: waiting for the approval of {names}
threads_outside_window: WhatsApp: the client has not written for 24 hours. Choose a template in Settings, or write by e-mail.
threads_write_hint: Write in the thread… @ to mention, Ctrl+Enter to send
org_empty_title: {org} has nothing in Kete Enterprise yet
org_empty_body: You came in with this organization. To open another one, change organization: you come straight back here.
plan_outlook_explain: Your Kete days in your calendar: meetings, absences and due days, refreshed every 30 minutes. The address is secret: whoever has it sees your days.
plan_outlook_how: In Outlook: Add calendar › From Internet, paste the address. It is shown once; « Renew » gives another one and closes this one.
policy_on_trial: On trial: observed, never enforced, until you turn it on.
policy_simulation_none: Over {count} gestures of the last 30 days, it would have changed nothing.
policy_simulation_some: It would have decided {count} of {replayed} gestures otherwise:
threads_outside_no_channel: WhatsApp is not connected to the organization: the message did not leave by WhatsApp. An administrator connects the number in Administration › Phone.
threads_deleted: Message deleted by {name} · the original stays in the proof
threads_only_for_you_why: Kete read beyond this thread with your rights, and others read it: this answer is visible to you only.
threads_notify_hint: Your phone rings only if your computer did not see it.
threads_delete_keeps: The message disappears from the thread for everyone; the original stays in the proof.
threads_field_hint: Enter sends · Shift+Enter breaks the line · drop files in the thread
threads_import_hint: A WhatsApp (.txt) or Telegram (.json) export, or a mail (.eml)
threads_imported_done: {imported} message(s) imported, {skipped} already there · {recognized} person(s) recognized
threads_merged: {count} message(s) moved; this thread is put away.
threads_voice_failed: The voice note could not be sent.
door_subtitle: Your thread · it acts with your rights, never more · it hands work to your agents
door_invite_hint: The conversation becomes a group: they will read all that came before.
door_handed_none: Nothing handed to your agents yet.
door_reads_list: your threads · your holdings · Plan · the documents you read
door_never_text: Decides for you, writes to a client without an approved template, acts beyond your rights, signs or pays.
door_drawer_text: On every page, the Kete button writes in this same thread, with the page as context.
door_policy_for: For people and agents, once adopted.
door_on_trial: On trial: observed before it applies
colleague_none: No agent works for you. Create one in a sentence.
colleague_pick: Pick an agent to talk to it.
colleague_delegate_of: delegate of {name} · never more rights than them
colleague_shared: shared with you · it acts with your rights
colleague_placeholder: Give {name} some work, or answer it…
colleague_expires: From a routine: without an answer by {time}, nothing leaves
colleague_never_sign: Signing and paying always come back to a person
colleague_take_other: Any other holding of its person
colleague_take_mention: It is mentioned in a thread
colleague_take_hint: The holding stays its person’s; the agent is only its delegate.
colleague_computer_off: No: everything goes through Kete’s tools
colleague_returns_hint: The result is always posted in the thread it was asked in.
colleague_trial: On trial until {day}: it only proposes
colleague_takeon_hint: You stay responsible; it returns it to you done.
mail_subtitle: What Kete reads, how it ranges, what is imported
mail_read_sent: Also read its Sent folder, by the same rule
mail_personal_title: What Kete reads in a personal box
mail_rule_contact: Exchanges with a known contact of an object (a client, a supplier, a project partner)
mail_rule_folder: The “Kete” folder: drop a mail in from Outlook, it enters its thread
mail_rule_address: A thread’s address in copy (once the domain is chosen)
mail_rule_never: Never the rest: a personal mail, or one between colleagues, enters no thread without a gesture of the person
mail_steps: How a mail finds its thread
mail_step_reply_hint: by its reply headers, whatever the address
mail_step_classify_hint: a person chooses; the rule is learned
mail_in_thread_text: A mail becomes a clean message — quoted history and signature removed —, its original one tap away; read in two boxes, it shows once. A reply sent from Outlook enters the thread with nothing to do.
mail_import_why: Why not live: WhatsApp does not open personal groups to software, and unofficial libraries get the number banned.
mail_domain_open: To decide: the domain of thread addresses, for example threads.your-domain.tg.
mail_domain_open_hint: Without it everything works; with it, each thread has its address and a mail in copy enters by itself.
mail_none: No box is connected: Kete reads no mail.
assets_explain: What the organization installs or owns and keeps for years, with its thread, its links and what is in progress.
assets_name_hint: For example: Solar plant · Tsévié school
assets_subtype_hint: For example: solar plant, pump, vehicle
asset_not_found: This asset does not exist, or it is not yours to read.
asset_nothing_in_progress: Nothing in progress on this asset.
place_not_found: This place does not exist, or it is not yours to read.
object_history_from_app: an event from {app}, about this object
object_history_from_kete: said by Kete when the object changes
measure_explain: Each indicator read now, with your rights, from {from} to {to}: where each figure comes from is said.
measure_none: No indicator yet: import your referential in Performance.
measure_whence: Where does this figure come from?
measure_none_live: No indicator has a source yet: each stays typed with its proof in Performance.
measure_typed_count: {count} indicators without a live source: typed each quarter in Performance.
